games.title: My Platformer
games.note: Boots straight into the Playtest Room now (no logo, title or menu); Start restarts the room fresh. Night sky: black with two layers of parallax stars that drift slower than you as you move. Ledges: touch a wall with its top edge anywhere between your hands and feet and you pop straight into the hang; the plug zipping to a socket near the top of a wall also ends in a hang. The brown mech yard door has a gap at the top: wall jump up either side (3 wall jumps) to get in and out without the mech.
